purpose: Teach: オマケ/脳みそ/右肩/負け犬/ペースト/方角/かわし/ひきこもり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオマケ付きのジュースをお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad picked up juice with a bonus prize inside.
lines.style: Warm and gentle, like sharing a small delight. Soft smile in the voice. Brief, unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、脳みそを使って算数解いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I solved the math problem all by myself!
lines.style: Bright and proud, bouncing slightly on the words. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm. The openness of a child who just learned something.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが右肩を冷やしてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's shoulder seemed sore today.
lines.style: Observant, thoughtful. Quiet concern underneath. Slow, measuring tone—she's noticing something small and caring about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絶対負け犬にはならないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to be strong and not give up.
lines.style: Firm and determined, but small-voiced. The seriousness of a child making a promise to himself. Steady eye contact held in the tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お母さんがゴマをペースト状に擦って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your mom ground the sesame seeds into paste for us.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the voice. Noticing the care behind a small act. Gentle and unhurried, like acknowledging a kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと方角の星座見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched the constellations with Dad and learned about directions!
lines.style: Excited and full of discovery. Eager pace, bright tone. The wonder of sharing something he learned with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがボールをかわしながら遊んで下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad played catch with you again today.
lines.style: Affectionate observation. Warm, approving tone. She's noticing the quiet constancy of his presence—no fanfare, just presence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ひきこもりにならないで外で遊ぶよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to go outside and play, not stay cooped up inside.
lines.style: Resolute and hopeful, a child's quiet vow. Steady tone, clear commitment. Not loud, but unmistakably sincere.
